concerns.text: The specification replaces the idea’s plan to use the existing CodeSearchNet developer‑comprehension benchmark (≈50 tasks) with a *new controlled user study* (US‑3). This changes the experimental methodology and introduces a different source of human performance data, effectively redefining the research approach without justification. The idea’s research question remains the same, but the way it will be answered has been altered, constituting a drift in scope.
